5.1_clear_cache.title: Clear session cache?
5.1_clear_cache.text: Clears this session from RAM: input, reply, thread, transparency, branches, attachments, timers. Does not change settings.json, Ollama, or image files on disk.

5.2_clear_all_plugin_data.title: Clear all plugin data?
5.2_clear_all_plugin_data.text: This resets bonsAI like a fresh install for this device. It deletes saved settings and permissions, runtime cache and plugin logs under Decky, and clears the Ollama host field, safety disclaimer flag, and unified-input persistence stored in the plugin browser. If Ollama on this Deck was enabled, this also removes downloaded models and the local Ollama install bonsAI set up under your account (~/.ollama and ~/.local/bin/ollama). It does not delete Desktop logs under bonsAI_logs. Afterward, set your Ollama host again and re-enable any permissions you need.
